title: The Dutch Golden Age
description: Light, intimacy, and virtuosity from the 17th-century Netherlands.
source: Rijksmuseum, The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Wikimedia Commons

items.title: Aristotle with a Bust of Homer
items.description_narrative: Rembrandt's 1653 oil painting depicts Aristotle, a philosopher, gazing intently at a bust of the epic poet Homer. The interplay of light and shadow highlights Aristotle's contemplative expression, suggesting a profound engagement with artistic legacy or philosophical inquiry.
items.tags: aristotle, homer, philosophy, portrait, dutch golden age, baroque, contemplation, oil painting

items.title: Portrait of a Man ("The Auctioneer")
items.description_narrative: This compelling oil on canvas by Rembrandt captures the likeness of a man, possibly an auctioneer, with an intense and thoughtful gaze. Painted in the artist's mature style, it exemplifies his mastery in conveying psychological depth through light and shadow.
items.tags: portrait, man, dutch golden age, oil painting, realism, psychological, solemn

items.title: Herman Doomer (ca. 1595–1650)
items.description_narrative: This portrait by Rembrandt depicts Herman Doomer, a prominent cabinetmaker of his time. Painted in 1640 using oil on wood, it showcases the artist's mastery of capturing individual character.
items.tags: portrait, baroque, dutch golden age, realism, man, oil painting

items.title: Portrait of Gerard de Lairesse
items.description_narrative: Rembrandt's 'Portrait of Gerard de Lairesse' is a compelling oil on canvas painting, completed between 1665 and 1667. This work showcases the artist's mastery in capturing the individuality and presence of his subject through a striking use of light and shadow.
items.tags: portrait, man, rembrandt, dutch golden age, baroque, oil painting, realism

items.title: Self-Portrait
items.description_narrative: This powerful self-portrait by Rembrandt captures the artist in his later years, revealing a profound introspection through his masterful use of light and shadow. The painting serves as a testament to his enduring artistic genius and a moving record of his personal journey.
items.tags: self-portrait, oil painting, rembrandt, dutch golden age, baroque, masterwork, portraiture, introspection

items.title: Hendrickje Stoffels (1626–1663)
items.description_narrative: Rembrandt's oil on canvas painting portrays Hendrickje Stoffels, dated to the mid-1650s. This work is a notable example of the artist's portraiture from this period.
items.tags: portrait, oil painting, Dutch Golden Age, Baroque, Rembrandt, 17th century

items.title: Bellona
items.description_narrative: Rembrandt's 1633 oil on canvas depicts Bellona, the Roman goddess of war. This work showcases the artist's early command of dramatic light and characterization.
items.tags: baroque, dutch golden age, mythology, goddess, oil painting, rembrandt, figure painting, war

items.title: Man in a Turban
items.description_narrative: Rembrandt's 'Man in a Turban' is a striking oil on canvas portrait from 1632. It exemplifies the artist's masterful use of light and shadow to create a sense of depth and character.
items.tags: portrait, oil painting, dutch golden age, rembrandt, chiaroscuro, baroque, man

items.title: Cottage near the Entrance to a Wood
items.medium: Pen and inks ranging from light to dark brown, brown washes, corrected in white (oxidized, partially abraded), and touches of red chalk (in added structures to the left of the main cottage).
items.description_narrative: This evocative drawing by Rembrandt depicts a humble cottage nestled near the entrance to a wood. Masterfully executed with a range of light to dark brown inks and washes, the work also features corrections in white and subtle touches of red chalk.
items.tags: rembrandt, dutch baroque, landscape, drawing, cottage, rural, ink, 17th century

items.title: Lucas van Uffel (died 1637)
items.description_narrative: This striking portrait captures Lucas van Uffel, a prominent merchant and art collector, with a discerning gaze. Anthony van Dyck masterfully uses oil on canvas to convey the sitter's status and intellectual depth.
items.tags: portrait, male figure, Baroque, oil painting, Flemish, formal, refined

items.title: Cottage among Trees
items.medium: Pen and brown ink, brush and brown wash, on paper washed with brown
items.description_narrative: Rembrandt masterfully renders a rustic cottage nestled amidst trees, utilizing expressive lines and washes to evoke a sense of humble rural life. The intricate interplay of pen and brown ink with broad brushstrokes of brown wash creates depth and atmosphere on the prepared paper.
items.tags: rembrandt, landscape, drawing, dutch baroque, rural scene, ink wash, cottage, trees

items.title: Christ Crucified between the Two Thieves: The Three Crosses
items.description_narrative: Rembrandt's dramatic drypoint depicts Christ's crucifixion, flanked by the two thieves, amidst a somber and emotionally charged scene. The artist masterfully uses the drypoint medium to create rich, dark tones and intricate details that heighten the intensity of this pivotal biblical event.
items.tags: religious, biblical, crucifixion, drypoint, Rembrandt, Dutch Golden Age, printmaking, dramatic

items.title: Reclining Female Nude
items.medium: Etching, drypoint, and engraving on Japanese paper; second of six states
items.description_narrative: This etching by Rembrandt depicts a reclining female nude, rendered with a combination of etching, drypoint, and engraving techniques. The artist's mastery of printmaking is evident in the nuanced tones and lines on the Japanese paper, showcasing the second of six states.
items.tags: nude, female, etching, drypoint, engraving, rembrandt, printmaking, dutch golden age

items.title: A Maid Asleep
items.description_narrative: This painting depicts a young maid asleep at a table, her posture suggesting a momentary lapse from her duties. Vermeer's meticulous attention to light and domestic detail creates a quiet, contemplative scene typical of his work.
items.tags: genre painting, domestic scene, quiet, oil painting, dutch golden age, interior, figure study

items.title: Study of a Young Woman
items.description_narrative: Johannes Vermeer captures a quiet moment with this intimate study of a young woman, her gaze direct yet enigmatic. Painted in oil on canvas, the work exemplifies the artist's masterful use of light and subtle brushwork to convey a sense of presence.
items.tags: young woman, figure study, Dutch Golden Age, oil painting, realism, intimate, portrait

items.title: Charity
items.description_narrative: Guido Reni's "Charity" exemplifies the artist's refined Baroque style through its graceful composition and idealized figures. This oil on canvas work from around 1630 portrays the allegorical figure of Charity, often depicted nourishing or caring for children, embodying selfless love.
items.tags: charity, allegory, baroque, italian baroque, religious, devotion, figurative

items.title: The Crucifixion with the Virgin and Saint John
items.description_narrative: Hendrick ter Brugghen's 'The Crucifixion with the Virgin and Saint John' depicts the somber biblical scene with dramatic intensity. Painted in oil on canvas, the work showcases the artist's masterful use of light and shadow to evoke emotional depth.
items.tags: religious, biblical, crucifixion, dutch golden age, caravaggism, sacred art, emotional

items.title: The Jabach Family
items.description_narrative: This grand portrait depicts the Jabach family, patrons of the arts, in a setting indicative of their wealth and intellectual pursuits. Charles Le Brun, a leading artist of his time, masterfully captures the family's presence and status through rich detail and classical composition.
items.tags: family portrait, baroque, french art, 17th century, oil painting, group portrait, aristocracy

items.title: The Fieschi Morgan Staurotheke
items.medium: Gilded silver, gold, enamel worked in cloisonné, and niello
items.description_narrative: The Fieschi Morgan Staurotheke is an exquisite Byzantine reliquary designed to hold a fragment of the True Cross. Crafted from gilded silver and gold, it features intricate cloisonné enamel and niello decoration, showcasing the skilled artistry of the early 9th century.
items.tags: byzantine, reliquary, gold, silver, enamel, christian, medieval, sacred art

items.title: Portrait of Alvise Contarini(?); (verso) A Tethered Roebuck
items.medium: Oil on wood; verso: oil and gold on wood
items.description_narrative: This painting features a probable portrait of Alvise Contarini on the front, rendered in oil on wood. The reverse side reveals 'A Tethered Roebuck,' executed with oil and gold on wood, showcasing the dual nature of the artwork.
items.tags: portrait, renaissance, italian, oil painting, roebuck, contemplative, venetian, 15th century

items.title: The Japanese Robe
items.description_narrative: This oil on canvas painting, "The Japanese Robe," by Alfred Stevens, depicts a woman in a richly appointed interior. Created around 1872, the work captures a moment of quiet contemplation, showcasing a popular fashion trend of the era.
items.tags: woman, interior, japonisme, elegant, 19th century, genre painting

items.title: The Death of Socrates
items.description_narrative: Jacques Louis David's monumental 1787 oil painting depicts the final moments of Socrates as he prepares to drink hemlock. Surrounded by his devoted students, Socrates remains stoic, pointing skyward in a gesture of philosophical defiance.
items.tags: socrates, classical, philosophy, death, neoclassicism, history painting, stoicism, sacrifice

items.title: Hermann von Wedigh III (died 1560)
items.description_narrative: Hans Holbein the Younger masterfully depicted Hermann von Wedigh III in this striking oil and gold on oak portrait. Painted in 1532, this work exemplifies Holbein's meticulous realism and attention to detail.
items.tags: portrait, renaissance, northern renaissance, 16th century, german, oil painting, formal, realism

items.title: Don Gaspar de Guzmán (1587–1645), Count-Duke of Olivares
items.description_narrative: This striking oil on canvas captures Don Gaspar de Guzmán, Count-Duke of Olivares, a prominent statesman and court favorite in 17th-century Spain. The portrait was skillfully rendered by Juan Bautista Martínez del Mazo, an artist associated with the Spanish court.
items.tags: portrait, nobleman, spanish art, baroque, 17th century, oil painting

items.title: Young Man and Woman in an Inn
items.description_narrative: Frans Hals's 'Young Man and Woman in an Inn' from 1623 captures a lively genre scene. This oil on canvas work showcases the artist's characteristic brushwork and engagement with everyday life.
items.tags: genre painting, Dutch Golden Age, oil painting, inn, tavern scene, casual, early 17th century

items.title: Boy with a Lute
items.description_narrative: Frans Hals captures a lively young musician in "Boy with a Lute," characteristic of his dynamic portraiture. This oil on canvas work exemplifies the artist's masterful brushwork and expressive style during the Dutch Golden Age.
items.tags: boy, lute, portrait, dutch golden age, baroque, expressive, music

items.title: Petrus Scriverius (1576–1660)
items.description_narrative: This oil painting by Frans Hals depicts Petrus Scriverius, a prominent figure from the 17th century. Created in 1626, it showcases Hals's characteristic lively brushwork and keen observation.
items.tags: portrait, oil painting, dutch golden age, baroque, male portrait, 17th century, frans hals

items.title: Jacob Willemsz van Veen (1456–1535), the Artist's Father
items.description_narrative: Maarten van Heemskerck captures his father, Jacob Willemsz van Veen, in this striking portrait. Executed in oil on wood in 1532, the work offers a personal glimpse into the artist's family.
items.tags: portrait, old master, oil painting, father, renaissance, 16th century, dutch art

items.title: The Smokers
items.description_narrative: Adriaen Brouwer's "The Smokers" depicts a group of men gathered in a dimly lit interior, their expressions animated as they indulge in tobacco and drink. This genre scene, rendered with a keen eye for detail and character, captures a moment of rustic conviviality characteristic of the artist's work.
items.tags: genre scene, Dutch Golden Age, smokers, tavern, everyday life, realism, oil painting, 17th century

items.title: Portrait of a Young Man
items.description_narrative: Bronzino's 'Portrait of a Young Man,' painted in oil on wood during the 1530s, exemplifies the artist's refined style and meticulous detail. The sitter's composed expression and elegant demeanor reflect the sophisticated portraiture characteristic of the period.
items.tags: portrait, young man, mannerism, italian renaissance, elegant, intense, sophisticated

items.title: The Annunciation
items.description_narrative: Petrus Christus's 'The Annunciation' depicts the pivotal biblical moment when the Archangel Gabriel announces to Mary that she will conceive Jesus. This significant oil on wood panel exemplifies the detailed artistry of early Netherlandish painting.
items.tags: annunciation, biblical, religious, oil painting, early netherlandish, sacred, petrus christus

items.title: Landschap met stenen brug
items.description_narrative: Rembrandt van Rijn's 'Landschap met stenen brug' depicts a dramatic scene with a storm gathering over a river and a sturdy stone arch bridge. The artist masterfully uses light and shadow to create a sense of impending drama and profound atmosphere within the Dutch landscape.
items.tags: landscape, bridge, river, storm, dutch golden age, baroque, dramatic, chiaroscuro

items.title: De Nachtwacht
items.description_narrative: Rembrandt's 'The Night Watch' depicts the company of Captain Frans Banninck Cocq and Lieutenant Willem van Ruytenburch moving out, renowned for its dramatic use of light and shadow. This monumental group portrait is a masterpiece of the Dutch Golden Age, celebrated for its dynamic composition and psychological depth.
items.tags: dutch golden age, group portrait, baroque, militia, dramatic, masterpiece, civic guard

items.title: Girl with a Pearl Earring
items.description_narrative: Often referred to as the 'Mona Lisa of the North', this tronie depicts a European girl wearing an exotic dress, an oriental turban, and what appears to be a very large pearl as an earring. It is a masterclass in the use of light.
items.tags: portrait, dutch golden age, pearl, turban, female

items.title: The Milkmaid
items.description_narrative: A kitchen maid carefully pours milk from a jug into an earthenware bowl, bathed in soft natural light from a window. Vermeer elevates an ordinary domestic scene into a meditation on quiet dignity and the beauty of everyday life.
items.tags: domestic, light, milk, kitchen, dutch golden age, still life
